queue.title: Kevin Warsh will deliver the Jackson Hole keynote on Friday, with his remarks likely to take one of two forms: a broader “big-picture” speech or a more traditional setup for the September-to-December policy meetings. The backdrop is challenging, with inflation still elevated, active debate over whether tighter policy is needed, and three dissents in favour of a hike at the July FOMC meeting.
queue.resumo: Warsh’s July press conference also raised questions about how willing the Committee is to tighten if inflation stays persistent, contributing to higher long-term inflation expectations and bond yields. If he chooses the broader approach, one likely topic is the Fed’s new task forces, where many details remain unclear around scope, interaction with the FOMC, timelines, and how recommendations could translate into changes to the Fed’s framework or operations.
